title: Support logs a call activity for Alan Frost
userProblem: I just had a call with Alan Frost at Cedar Health about the clinic scheduling integration. Log it as a call activity linked to the clinic scheduling module deal.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent creates a new activity record (type call) linked to con_004 and dls_003, and confirms the new activity id.

assertions.description: Agent must call create_record to log the activity.
Create must target the activity type.
One new activity for con_004 (seed has act_002).
Answer confirms the activity was created.

rationale: Core create scenario: support agent logs a call activity, which support_agent is permitted to create.
